title: Aggregation of [LnIII]12 clusters by the dianion of 3-formylsalicylic acid. Synthesis, crystal structures, magnetic and luminescence properties

synthesis.procedure: The three compounds were obtained by the same general procedure. A stoichiometric amount of 40% tetrabutylammonium hydroxide solution in water (0.052 g, 2 mmol) was added to a 1:1 methanol/DMF solution (10 mL) of 3-formylsalicylic acid (0.017 g, 1 mmol). The resulting solution was stirred for about 2 h at room temperature, then added to a solution of 1 mmol Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (Ln = Eu for 1) in 1:1 methanol/DMF (10 mL). The reaction mixture was stirred for 3 h. Yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were obtained by slow evaporation at room temperature.
synthesis.time: stirred ~2 h then 3 h; crystals by slow evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction obtained by slow evaporation at room temperature.

properties.summary: Solid-state EuIII luminescence: bright red emission visible to the naked eye under low-power 420 nm LED excitation. Emission spectra at 80 K and 300 K (λex = 420 nm) and excitation spectra monitored near 615 nm. Emission lifetime monitored at 615 nm lengthens from 120 μs at 300 K to 500 μs at 80 K, attributed to reduced back energy transfer from 5D0 to the ligand triplet.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same general procedure as 1, using Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (1 mmol) in place of the Eu salt. Tetrabutylammonium hydroxide (40% aq., 0.052 g, 2 mmol) was added to 3-formylsalicylic acid (0.017 g, 1 mmol) in 1:1 methanol/DMF (10 mL), stirred ~2 h at room temperature, then combined with the Ln nitrate in 1:1 methanol/DMF (10 mL) and stirred 3 h. Yellow crystals formed by slow evaporation at room temperature.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of the Gd12 cluster: χMT = 94.4 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature (12 isolated GdIII, S = 7/2), decreasing below 70 K to 50.6 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, indicating antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd interactions. Isothermal magnetization saturates near 70 μB at 2.2 K / 7 T. Specific heat (0.3–30 K) shows a zero-field Schottky maximum at 0.91 K. Magnetocaloric entropy change S(7 T) − S(0 T) = 20R = 166 J mol−1 K−1 (maximum near 3 K), corresponding to 1.7R per GdIII.

properties.summary: χMT = 160.0 cm3 mol−1 K at room temperature, lower than the value for 12 isolated DyIII ions, and decreases on cooling due to Stark-level depopulation and antiferromagnetic interactions. Frequency-dependent in-phase and out-of-phase AC susceptibility under zero DC field indicates SMM behaviour. Relaxation fitted to τ = τQTM + τ0 exp(−Ueff/kT) gives Ueff = 22.9 cm−1, τ0 = 8.75 × 10−7 s, and τQTM = 1.31 × 10−4 s (data below 8.5 K).
